definitions.explanation: The planet Earth and all its inhabitants.
A particular area of activity or experience.

notes:
{世界|せかい} has two main meanings: the physical world/earth, and a realm or sphere of activity.

MEANINGS:
1. The world/earth: ⟦{世界|せかい}{中|じゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (travel around the world)
2. A realm/sphere: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世界|せかい} (the world of music)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{世界|せかい}{中|じゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧: all over the world
- {世界|せかい}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: worldwide, global
- {世界|せかい}⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧: world's best, number one in the world
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧{世界|せかい}: the whole world
